thesis: The site is a dark-sky trail through the shop: each section is a numbered lamp stop lit in amber on a deep pine-night field, and scrolling walks the visitor from the door to the sealed bag.

signature.name: lamp-stops
signature.summary: Numbered amber-lit pools (01 Door → 06 Pickup) at the left margin (desktop) or top pill (mobile); only the current stop is fully lit. Photo lives inside the pool. Hook: data-sw-signature='lamp-stop'.

motion.intro: Page starts dark; lamp 01 warms behind headline in ≤1s.
stories: lamps light one-by-one in first-visit while filmstrip frame slides into pool
